beats.say: The spider on your window can jump 40 times its own length.
It locks onto a fly, and launches.
At night, it hangs from a silk thread. And its eyes twitch.
About every 17 minutes, its legs curl and jerk.
Scientists can't say yet if it dreams. But when it wakes,
